{{Quote|We've learned from our many informants in your ranks that a batch of your forces in the Taris system is angling for Zongorlu next. What you may not know is that those weren't all military camps on Serroco that Mandalore so callously and criminally nuked. There were vacation camps for Zongorlu younglings &mdash; nine camps, representing every major warrior-tribe on the planet! ''[&hellip;]'' I don't think I'd come to Zongorlu if I were you.|Propaganda broadcast by "Captain Goodvalor," addressed at Mandalorian Neo-Crusader soldiers|<ref name="Interference" />}}
'''Zongorlu''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Noonian sector/Legends|Noonian sector]]. It was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], [[Plant/Legends|plant]]-like [[Zongorlu (species)|Zongorlu]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. In [[3963 BBY]], during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] transmission station was located on Zongorlu, from which [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] broadcasts were made by an [[Marn Hierogryph's brother|actor]] performing the persona of Republic "[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Benegryph Goodvalor|Goodvalor]]."

After the Republic learned that its enemy in the war, the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]], planned to advance to Zongorlu after having [[Taris Siege|occupied]] the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], "Goodvalor" began making various false claims about Zongorlu on the broadcasts, aiming to demoralize the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. Nevertheless, the Neo-Crusaders, including [[Koblus Sornell]], did travel to Zongorlu, with the surprised Sornell then informing the Mandalorian [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Cassus Fett]] of the truth about the planet and about the Republic propagandist having narrowly escaped them. Between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], Zongorlu was part of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].

==Description==
{{Quote|In the meantime, this Republic weather report for Zongorlu: Hurricane-force winds across much of the planet, with magnetic storms throughout the ionosphere. Searing heat at the surface, with intermittent pyroclastic flows from some of the larger volcanic ranges. Atmospheric sulfur content remains high, with acidic rains in the polar regions. Essentially, for Zongorlu, a temperate day.|Propaganda broadcast by "Captain Goodvalor"|<ref name="Interference" />}}
[[File:Noonian_sector.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Zongorlu was situated in the Noonian sector.]]
Zongorlu was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Interference" /> located in the [[Zongorlu system/Legends|Zongorlu system]], a part of the [[Noonian sector/Legends|Noonian sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> According to<ref name="Interference" /> the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]]<ref name="War1">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 1|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 1]]</ref> [[Koblus Sornell]], the planet posed no difficulties to [[Starship/Legends|starships]] landing on its surface, and it could have good weather. At times it [[Water/Legends|rained]] on Zongorlu, although arid periods could also last a [[Standard week/Legends|week]].<ref name="Interference" />

In contrast to Zongorlu's actual relatively mild conditions, [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] propaganda described it as a searingly [[Temperature/Legends|hot]] world with an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] rich in [[Sulfur/Legends|sulfur]]. It supposedly featured [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] ranges, the larger of which could sometimes emit pyroclastic flows, while its weather could consist of [[Hurricane/Legends|hurricanes]] across much of the surface and [[Acid/Legends|acidic]] rains in the polar regions. Finally, Zongorlu's ionosphere was also claimed to have frequent [[Magnetic storm/Legends|magnetic storms]]. Furthermore, Republic propaganda characterized the totality of the above conditions as "a temperate [[Local day/Legends|day]]" for Zongorlu.<ref name="Interference" />

==History==
===Zongorlu unseen===
{{Quote|So many ships! So many troops! I'm not sure if Zongorlu has nearly enough space for all of us.|Propaganda broadcast by "Captain Goodvalor"|<ref name="Interference" />}}
Koblus Sornell, a signals expert with the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusader]] faction of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture, would eventually describe the abandoned starships [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] Zongorlu as looking as if they had already been in that state when<ref name="Interference" /> Mandalorian forces [[Mandalorian Crusades|traveled]] through the planet's vicinity under the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|command]] of<ref name="TEA" /> [[Mandalore the Indomitable]]<ref name="Interference" /> during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] of [[3996 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> In [[3963 BBY]], during the [[Mandalorian Wars|war]] between the Galactic Republic and the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders,<ref name="Interference" /> the [[Actor/Legends|actor]] [[Marn Hierogryph's brother|brother]] of the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] accidental Republic hero [[Marn Hierogryph]],<ref name="KOTOR47">[[Knights of the Old Republic 47|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 47]]</ref> the former of whom was performing the persona of "[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Benegryph Goodvalor|Goodvalor]]," transmitted a series of Republic [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] broadcasts aimed at Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] from a transmission station on Zongorlu.<ref name="Interference" />

[[File:Zongorlu-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|300px|During the Mandalorian Wars, Zongorlu became a target for Mandalorian forces on the planet Taris.]]
After it became known to "Goodvalor" that the Mandalorian [[Taris Siege|occupation]] force on<ref name="Interference" /> the [[Ojoster sector/Legends|Ojoster sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] was going to also dispatch soldiers to Zongorlu, in order to try and dissuade the would-be invaders, in his broadcasts the "captain" began making various false claims about Zongorlu, including about the presence of a massive Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] at the planet that extended "to the next [[Star system/Legends|system]]." The propaganda claims made Sornell believe that the transmitter of the [[mobile signal station]] that the Mandalorians planned to install on Zongorlu would require heavy-duty shielding. The Neo-Crusaders also attempted to perform reconnaissance of the world before traveling there, but they were unable to confirm any of the claims made by the Republic.<ref name="Interference" />

===Zongorlu visited===
{{Quote|First, the planet. Those reports we were getting were full of gas. The planet's decent enough &mdash; good weather, no problem getting down at all.|Transmission by Koblus Sornell|<ref name="Interference" />}}
[[File:Koblus_Sornell.png|thumb|right|300px|Koblus Sornell was among the Mandalorians who visited Zongorlu.]]
The Mandalorian forces, including Sornell, a [[Field Marshal/Legends|Field Marshal]], and the [[Shaadlar-type troopship|''Shaadlar''-type troopship]] ''[[Nehutyc]]'', eventually did travel to and land on Zongorlu, in the process discovering the transmission station from which Hierogryph's [[Gender/Legends|brother]] had fled on a small starship shortly before the Neo-Crusader arrival. The surprised Devaronian subsequently sent a transmission to [[Cassus Fett]]<ref name="Interference" />&mdash;the aide-de-camp of Mandalore the Indomitable's successor, [[Mandalore the Ultimate]]<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>&mdash;relaying to him the true nature of the planet. Later, while the Neo-Crusaders on Zongorlu were awaiting their next orders from Fett, some of the bored soldiers began setting the local [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] on [[Fire/Legends|fire]], a practice that Sornell then scolded due to the risk of the dry weather causing the fire to spread to the Mandalorian camp.<ref name="Interference" />

After the Mandalorians had been on Zongorlu for at least a week-long uneventful period of [[Time/Legends|time]], "Goodvalor" made another broadcast, claiming that the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]] had been "called away unexpectedly." He additionally attributed the negligible evidence of Republic presence on the planet to that state's "commitment to the environment" and efforts to make Zongorlu appear "even more peaceful" than it did prior to its arrival there. The "captain" then went on to offer a supposed peace offer from the Republic, addressed to the "Mandalorian representative on Zongorlu."<ref name="Interference" /> The planet remained outside the "civilized [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]," or the territories that had been widely [[Scout/Legends|explored]] by the Republic, by the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]] of [[3959 BBY]]&ndash;[[3956 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> Between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], Zongorlu fell within the territory of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|And the shock troops were a waste. The Zongorlu are a ''plant species''. They're sentient, all right, but they're big and lumpy and they move about a meter a day. They kind of blinked when we landed.|Transmission by Koblus Sornell|<ref name="Interference" />}}
Zongorlu was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to a [[Species/Legends|species]] of large, slow-moving, [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Plant/Legends|plants]] called the [[Zongorlu (species)|Zongorlu]]. According to false claims by Galactic Republic propaganda, the Zongorlu society was organized into warrior-tribes, with the species also being [[Senator/Legends|represented]] in the Republic's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]].<ref name="Interference" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|I'm talking to you from a transmission station, all right &mdash; but it's not the one we brought. From the logs, as best as I can tell &mdash; ''this'' was where that guy was talking to us from. ''[&hellip;]'' They've got a directional transmitter here, which we're guessing they were using to target points on the Outer Rim. All the time this so-called "Captain" was talking about his big ship, he's been sitting in a little room you couldn't fit a basilisk in, gnawing on dried dreeka fish and running his mouth!|Transmission from Koblus Sornell to Cassus Fett|<ref name="Interference" />}}
During the Mandalorian Wars, Zongorlu was the site of a small Galactic Republic transmission station equipped with a [[directional transmitter]]. At the time, a small number of abandoned starships were also located in the planet's orbit. The fictionalized version of Zongorlu decribed in "Captain Goodvalor's" propaganda broadcasts featured several [[Fortress/Legends|citadels]]. The Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders eventually also established a camp on Zongorlu, with it including a mobile signal station.<ref name="Interference" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zongorlu was introduced in "[[Interference]]," a [[2008]] short story written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and published on [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]].<ref name="Interference" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Zongorlu system, and thereby the planet itself, in grid square M-6.<ref name="TEA" />
